subject.title: TUI: Add config support for --deliver flag default

question: Should OpenClaw add a persistent TUI delivery default, and should the canonical config key be `tui.deliver`?
rationale: The missing capability is clear, but repository policy sets a high bar for new config/default surfaces and current docs intentionally make delivery an explicit launch-time choice.

options.title: Approve `tui.deliver`
options.body: Add a narrow boolean config default with schema, help labels, docs, and tests while keeping explicit CLI flags highest precedence.

options.title: Keep flag-only behavior
options.body: Decline the new config surface and rely on `openclaw tui --deliver`, shell aliases, and current docs now that the adjacent abort hang was fixed separately.

options.title: Use a session preference instead
options.body: Reject a global config key and design a TUI-owned persisted preference or settings flow if maintainers want per-session behavior.

recommendation.title: Approve `tui.deliver`
recommendation.body: Add a narrow boolean config default with schema, help labels, docs, and tests while keeping explicit CLI flags highest precedence.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision is mainly about the TUI launch/config contract, and the original TUI delivery surface traces back to this owner signal.
